conditions.browser: Chromium (Playwright build), macOS system fonts, deviceScaleFactor 1

candidates.name: d3r1B
candidates.idea: 测试把更多空间给职责的另一种取舍，同时维持工号、职级和部门的基本可读性；重点观察较窄日期列是否导致不可接受的数字断行。
candidates.label: bad

whys: 工号和职责表头完整，职责正文相对较宽，整体也较紧凑；但姓名、部门和职责仍有许多不自然的断行，部分日期的年份被拆开，影响比较。
IDs remain whole and responsibilities have enough width for relatively continuous reading. Names and departments wrap, however, and some years split within the date, making date lookup harder.
工号完整，职责列相对宽裕；部分日期仍把年份拆开，部门和职责的断行也不自然，但行高分布比 A 略紧凑。

candidates.name: d2r1A
candidates.idea: 以 B 为基础，将姓名和部门各加宽到可容纳两个汉字的宽度，保留完整工号和职级代码；职责列仍比 A 宽，日期维持紧凑。需检验日期断行与职责阅读是否仍可接受。
candidates.label: bad

whys: 工号完整，日期多半按年份与月日分行，但职责栏很窄，中文词组频繁断开，长行记录使其他列出现大片空白；职级和职责表头也被拆行。

IDs stay whole and dates generally break at hyphens, aiding lookup. The narrower responsibilities column produces more fragmented phrases and substantially taller rows; its header also wraps awkwardly.
工号完整，多数日期按年份与月日分行；但职责列更窄，表头和正文都被频繁切断，长行记录显著增高。

candidates.name: d1r1A
candidates.idea: 以A为基础，将日期列收窄9px并转给职责列，保留完整工号和职级以及姓名、部门的两字阅读宽度。测试职责多容纳文字能否改善长行，同时观察日期是否出现难以辨认的数字断行。
candidates.label: bad

whys: 职责表头完整，正文比 A 更易连读，工号也完整；但多数日期的年份被拆开，查找和比较入职日期困难，姓名和部门也频繁换行。
The responsibilities column reads much like B, but the slightly narrower date column splits more years and makes one short row taller. IDs remain easy to scan.
工号保持完整，主要职责的表头也在一行；但日期多处把年份拆开，部门和职责频繁断行，查阅与连续阅读都费力。

candidates.name: contrast
candidates.idea: This near-equal allocation fits the width but gives the employee identifiers less than their measured unbreakable width plus padding. It also leaves the long responsibilities text severely constrained while giving the short rank values unnecessary space.
candidates.label: bad

whys: 等宽分配使工号断行，职责栏每行只有很少的字，长记录延伸至 17 行；大量纵向空白和断开的词组严重妨碍查找及阅读。
Employee IDs split across lines, dates fragment, and the responsibilities column forces text into very narrow stacks. The resulting tall rows make comparison difficult.
等宽分配把工号拆成两行，职责列仅容纳很少的字，长记录被拉成细长文字柱；跨行定位和比较十分吃力。
日期多按年份与月日分行，职责栏较宽；但姓名和部门逐字竖向排列，多个表头拆行，员工身份与所属部门难以快速识别。
Dates and responsibilities have useful width, but names and departments become one-character stacks. This disrupts recognition and makes even short entries occupy tall rows; four headers wrap.
日期和职责获得较多空间，但姓名与部门几乎逐字竖排，四个表头换行，姓名和部门的快速识别受到明显影响。

d1.purpose: 在手机宽度内查阅员工身份、组织归属、职级、入职时间和主要职责。
tasks: 按工号或姓名定位员工，并横向读取同一行的信息
比较员工的部门、职级和入职日期
逐行阅读主要职责，了解工作分工
relations: 工号和姓名共同识别员工；其余单元格描述同一名员工
部门与主要职责共同说明组织归属和工作内容
职级和入职日期分别支持资历与时间上的比较
roles: 首行为列标题；其余各行为一名员工
工号、姓名用于定位；部门、职级、入职日期用于分类和比较；主要职责承载较长的描述
keep_whole: 姓名中的字应保持正确顺序，尽量不拆分姓名
日期应保持数字顺序，并尽量在连字符处换行
may_wrap: 部门名称可按中文自然换行，尽量保持词组完整
主要职责可按中文语义自然换行
空间不足时姓名和日期也可能换行
same_scale: 姓名和部门都是短文本，但部门名称通常更长，可给予更多空间
工号和日期都是需准确查读的标识性信息，宽度应以各自内容为准
主要职责比其他列长得多，应视阅读任务获得更大的宽度
d1.h_vs_v: 六列无法同时容纳所有内容的单行宽度；必须用增加行高换取可读性。优先保证工号和职级完整，再在姓名、部门、日期和职责之间分配有限空间。

d2.purpose: 在手机宽度内呈现员工花名册，关联每位员工的身份、组织、职级、入职时间和职责。
tasks: 通过工号或姓名定位员工
查看并比较员工的部门、职级和入职日期
阅读每位员工的主要职责
relations: 每行的六个单元格共同描述一位员工
工号和姓名用于识别，部门与职级用于组织和岗位比较，日期与职责提供补充信息
roles: 首行是列标题，其余五行是员工记录
工号和姓名承担实际上的行识别作用，主要职责是内容最长的描述列
keep_whole: 姓名和完整日期尽量保持一行
may_wrap: 主要职责可按中文语义自然换行
空间紧张时，姓名可在汉字之间换行，日期可在连字符处换行
same_scale: 姓名与部门都是简短中文标签，宽度应按各自内容和识别作用协调
工号与职级都是短标识，但工号需要更宽以保持完整
d2.h_vs_v: 360px 内无法同时让所有短字段和职责都保持单行；给职责更多宽度可以减少长段落换行，但会迫使姓名、部门或日期拆行。

d3.purpose: 在手机视口内呈现员工花名册，供读者识别员工并查看其组织、职级、入职时间和职责。
tasks: 按工号或姓名查找员工
比较部门、职级和入职日期
阅读各员工的主要职责
relations: 每行的工号和姓名共同标识一名员工，其余单元格描述同一员工
部门和职级提供组织与职位信息，入职日期提供时间信息，主要职责描述工作内容
roles: 首行是列标题，标明各字段
其余各行分别对应一名员工，没有声明的行标题
工号是紧凑的识别码，姓名是主要的人名标识；主要职责是篇幅最长的说明字段
keep_whole: 姓名中的人名尽量保持完整
日期及其中的数字片段尽量保持完整
部门名称和职责中的词语尽量保持完整
may_wrap: 部门名称可在汉字之间换行，但应尽量保持词语连续
入职日期可在可用断点处换行
主要职责是连续说明，可随列宽自然换行
较长姓名在空间不足时可能换行
same_scale: 工号和职级都是短识别字段，应保持紧凑
姓名和部门都是短中文字段，需要足够空间支持识别
主要职责的信息量远大于其他字段，应获得更多换行空间
d3.h_vs_v: 六列在360px内无法同时容纳所有字段单行显示；增加短字段宽度可改善查找，但会压缩职责列并显著增加行高。

analysis.strengths: Employee IDs remain whole, the two-character name and department headers fit, and the responsibilities header stays on one line. The responsibilities column has the most space of the three layouts.
analysis.faults: Dates frequently break within the year, making them difficult to scan. Names and departments also wrap, and the long responsibilities produce tall rows. The grade and date headers wrap.
analysis.spatial_logic: P protects the identifier and gives the remaining flexible space largely to responsibilities, leaving only 34 px of text space for dates.

analysis.strengths: Like P, Q keeps IDs and the responsibilities header whole. One extra pixel in the date column preserves the full year in more rows; one of those rows becomes shorter. It has the fewest measured word breaks and the shortest overall table.
analysis.faults: Two dates still split within the year, while names, departments and longer responsibilities remain heavily wrapped. The grade and date headers occupy two lines.
analysis.spatial_logic: Q moves one pixel from responsibilities to dates. That small change crosses a wrapping threshold for some years without visibly changing the responsibilities wrapping.

analysis.strengths: The wider date column keeps the year together in every row and makes most dates easier to read in two lines. IDs remain whole.
analysis.faults: The narrow responsibilities column breaks its own header and fragments the descriptions into as many as 11 lines. The resulting table is substantially taller, with more measured word breaks and weaker continuity in the column containing the most text.
analysis.spatial_logic: R transfers eight pixels from responsibilities to dates relative to Q. The date improvement is clear, but the loss of width in the text-heavy column has a much larger effect on the table's height and reading rhythm.

rounds.insights: The table is tightly constrained: IDs already need their full allocation, while the name and department columns are only wide enough for roughly two Chinese characters per line. The comparison shows that a single pixel can change date wrapping, whereas taking several pixels from responsibilities can greatly increase row heights. Q is the strongest observed balance, though its split years remain a significant lookup problem. Nearby allocations should be rendered and checked because their wrapping cannot be predicted reliably from widths alone.

analysis.strengths: The table fits the viewport, and employee IDs remain intact in a consistently sized first column.
analysis.faults: The duties column is very narrow, producing fragmented Chinese phrases and exceptionally tall rows. Names and departments also wrap, while some dates break within the year. Three headers wrap.
analysis.spatial_logic: The long duties cells determine row height, leaving large vertical areas empty in the other columns. The narrow grade and date columns make the header taller without giving the duties enough useful width.

analysis.strengths: It fits the viewport and keeps the duties header on one line. One extra pixel in the duties column substantially improves wrapping, reducing the table height and the number of measured breaks inside words.
analysis.faults: Names and departments remain fragmented, dates still wrap awkwardly and some years split, and the grade and date headers occupy two lines. Long duties remain difficult to read continuously.
analysis.spatial_logic: The slightly wider duties column crosses a useful wrapping threshold, making the long rows considerably shorter. Duties still dominate row height and leave substantial empty space beside them.

rounds.insights: Layout Q shows that a single pixel can change Chinese text wrapping substantially, so refinements should be judged from renders rather than width alone. The strongest remaining conflict is between readable dates and enough width for duties; preserving complete employee IDs already consumes a necessary share of the viewport.

analysis.strengths: 工号和职级保持完整；日期多数在年份后换行；主要职责标题保持一行。
analysis.faults: 姓名和部门几乎逐字竖排，妨碍识别和查找；职级标题也被拆成两行。第三条日期分成三行。
analysis.spatial_logic: 窄姓名和部门栏省出的宽度给了日期与职责，但短职责的行仍被逐字排列的部门撑高。

analysis.strengths: 工号和职级值保持完整，日期多数在年份后换行。
analysis.faults: 姓名和部门仍逐字排列；职级栏加宽后标题仍换行，职责栏却更窄，长职责出现多达11行，表格明显拉长。
analysis.spatial_logic: 增加职级宽度没有带来相应的可读性收益，却从最需要空间的职责栏取走宽度。

analysis.strengths: 姓名和部门能够以两个字为一组阅读，两个标题也各占一行；短职责行明显缩短，整体更紧凑。
analysis.faults: 日期栏过窄，后两条年份在数字中间断开，其余日期也拆成三行；职级标题仍换行，长职责的语句断行较碎。
analysis.spatial_logic: 把宽度用于姓名和部门改善了查找，也减少了空白行高；但日期被压到了破坏数字连续性的程度。

rounds.insights: 在360px内，姓名和部门达到容纳两个汉字的宽度有明显收益；职级栏加宽到51px则没有同等收益。Q的主要问题是日期，适当恢复日期宽度可能改善数字阅读，但必须检验职责栏收窄后的代价。

bad.why: A one-pixel reduction in the responsibilities column forces the header and much of the prose onto more lines, while dates still split inside the year.
Names and departments fall into single-character lines, making the roster hard to scan and the entries hard to recognize.
Names and departments run one character per line, while the narrow responsibilities column fragments the prose and makes the table exceptionally tall.
Several dates split inside the four-digit year; the extra pixel given to responsibilities does not visibly compensate for the loss of date readability.

contrast.why: This near-equal allocation fits the width but gives the employee identifiers less than their measured unbreakable width plus padding. It also leaves the long responsibilities text severely constrained while giving the short rank values unnecessary space.

sameFunctionGroups.why: Both contain short Chinese labels used for lookup, but department names are generally longer than personal names. Equal widths are a practical compromise in these candidates, not a requirement of their shared role.

synthesis.rationale: Q makes the best use of the narrow responsibilities column: its header stays on one line and the long descriptions remain substantially more compact. R offers a distinct tradeoff by keeping four-digit years intact, which helps date lookup, but its narrower responsibilities column breaks more prose into short lines and makes the table taller. Both fit the viewport and retain intact employee identifiers, though neither gives all fields comfortable reading room.

general: Allocate width according to content and lookup needs; a small change near a wrapping threshold can materially alter the whole table.
Preserve identifiers and meaningful parts of dates where possible, and assess prose breaks as well as total table height.
specific: The employee-number column needs 74 px to accommodate its 53 px identifier and fixed padding and border.
At these widths, responsibilities change sharply between 82 px and 83 px, while 64 px gives dates more coherent breaks than 55–57 px.

synthesis.tradeoffs: Q favors reading responsibilities and compact rows, but splits the years 2020 and 2023. R preserves the years and improves date scanning at the cost of a wrapped responsibilities header, more fragmented prose, and greater height.
synthesis.uncertain: Acceptance depends on whether readers prioritize responsibilities or date lookup. The fixed 360 px width prevents all fields from retaining natural breaks; neither finalist fully resolves that constraint.

critique.good: 工号和职级代码完整；姓名和部门大多能以每行两字显示，行内查找关系清楚。日期多数分成两行，整体保持可辨认。
critique.problems: 主要职责每行容纳的字数少，长职责被切成很多短行，阅读不连贯，也造成较高的行和大片空白。部分日期分成三行，姓名与部门仍有词组被拆开；三个表头换行。
critique.cause: 职责列75px仅留约54px文字宽度；日期列64px对部分日期不足，姓名和部门各53px也不足以完整显示较长内容。

critique.good: 工号、职级和完整日期易于查找和比较，姓名大多每行两字。
critique.problems: 职责几乎逐字竖排，阅读十分困难；部门也逐字换行。长行高使同一行的信息相隔很远，整表过长，严重妨碍查阅。
critique.cause: 日期列106px占用过多宽度，导致职责列仅48px、部门列仅38px。

critique.good: 职责列较宽，职责文本更易连续阅读；整体高度较低，主要职责表头完整显示。
critique.problems: 部分工号和职级代码断开，损害准确查找；姓名和部门逐字换行，阅读生硬，部门还抬高了短职责行。日期有多种断法，四个表头换行。
critique.cause: 工号列73px比完整工号所需宽度少1px；职级列39px也不足以稳定容纳代码。姓名、部门各37px，文字区不足以并排容纳两个汉字；日期列63px偏紧。

critique.good: 工号和职级代码完整，主要职责标题单行显示；在三个方案中整体高度最小，职责列的阅读宽度也较实用。
critique.problems: 部分姓名被拆开，部门名称频繁换行；日期中的年份被拆成数字片段，难以快速比较。职级标题竖向排列，职责文字也有不少不自然的断行。
critique.cause: 姓名和部门各为53px，仅够两个汉字；日期55px不足以容纳完整年份及连字符；职级40px不足以容纳两个标题字。

critique.good: 工号和职级代码完整；92px的职责列为长文本提供了三个方案中最大的宽度。
critique.problems: 日期标题逐字排成四行，抬高整个表头；日期数字被拆得更碎，削弱时间比较。职责列增宽后，主要长职责行仍与d1r1A一样高，换来的改善有限。
critique.cause: 日期列从55px缩至47px，文字空间不足；增加到职责列的8px并未显著减少最长几行的行数。

critique.good: 64px的日期列让多数日期在年份后的连字符处换行，日期比其他方案容易查读；工号和职级代码完整。
critique.problems: 职责标题换行，长职责被切成很短的片段，导致表格明显变高；姓名和部门仍有频繁换行，职级标题仍竖排。
critique.cause: 日期列增宽挤占了职责列，使其降至75px；姓名、部门和职级列分别仍为53px、53px和40px。

critique.good: 工号和大多数姓名保持完整；部门按两字一组排列，员工身份较容易定位。表格恰好适合视口。
critique.problems: 职责列过窄，长句被切成许多短行，三条长记录拉得很高；日期中的年份被拆开，难以比较。职级和日期标题也换行。
critique.cause: 职责列仅69px，日期列55px；姓名列68px占用的空间虽有助于姓名阅读，却加剧了长职责的拥挤。

critique.good: 工号完整，较宽的部门列减少了部门名称的行数；表格适合视口。
critique.problems: 多个姓名被拆开，部门名称也出现不自然的断词；职责仍是密集短行，日期年份仍被拆开。长行记录造成大量纵向空白。
critique.cause: 姓名列53px只能容纳约两个汉字，部门列68px虽可容纳约三个字，但未必对应词组边界；职责列69px和日期列55px仍然过窄。

critique.good: 工号和职级代码完整，表格适合视口；部门以两字一组显示，比三字断开更有规律。
critique.problems: 职责依然被切成短行，日期年份被拆开，多个姓名换行；职级列多出的空间没有改善已换行的标题，也未降低行高。
critique.cause: 职级列51px仍不足以让两字标题同排，却挤占了职责和日期的空间；职责73px、日期55px仍不足以提供流畅阅读。

critique.good: 四个方案中职责最易连续阅读，职责标题保持一行，长记录明显缩短；工号和职级代码完整，表格适合视口。
critique.problems: 三字及四字姓名被拆开，日期年份有时被拆成两行，妨碍定位和时间比较；部门和职责仍有一些不自然的断词。短内容列在长职责行旁留下较多空白。
critique.cause: 姓名和部门各53px，日期55px；职责84px虽较其他方案宽，但在六列共享360px时仍只能容纳有限的中文。

critique.good: 工号和职级代码完整；大多数姓名保持单行，日期多数能在连字符附近换行。
critique.problems: 主要职责被挤成每行约两个字，词组频繁断开，长行记录异常高，横向关联员工信息也变得困难。部门名称多次换行。
critique.cause: 姓名列为68px，而职责列仅60px；日期列64px仍不足以让所有日期都按相同方式断行。

d2r3B.idea: 以较窄日期列换取姓名和职责空间，尝试让多数姓名保持完整，同时检查日期能否在连字符处清晰换行。

d2r3C.idea: 优先扩展职责列，减少长记录的断行和高度；检查53px日期列的数字段是否仍保持完整。

d1r3A.idea: 将日期加宽至可容纳四位年份的程度，争取在连字符处换行；从职责列借出9px，检验日期比较与职责阅读之间的取舍。

d3r3A.idea: 以 d3r2A 为基础，将日期列加宽 4px，测试日期数字片段能否更稳定地保持完整；职责列相应收窄，观察日期查阅改善是否值得增加正文换行。

d1r3B.idea: 让三字姓名和四位年份各保持一行，优先改善员工定位及日期比较；检验职责列缩窄后的代价是否可接受。

d3r3B.idea: 探索优先保持姓名和职责可读性的分配：姓名列加宽，职责列恢复到 d3r2A 的宽度，代价是部门列收窄。需检视部门逐字换行是否仍能支持组织信息查阅。

d1r3C.idea: 将更多空间留给职责，探索能否进一步减少长记录的断行和高度；日期列收窄，需重点检查数字及连字符的换行是否仍可读。

d2r4A.idea: 保留完整工号和年份数字段，将姓名列加宽以容纳三字姓名；观察进一步压缩职责列后，识别效率的提升是否值得正文高度的代价。

d2r4B.idea: 保留日期数字段，并让职级标题保持一行；检验更清楚的标题层级是否能抵消职责列变窄造成的阅读负担。

d2r4C.idea: 加宽部门列，以减少部门名称的零碎换行，同时保留工号和日期数字段；检验部门比较是否因此改善，以及职责列变窄的代价。

d1r4A.idea: 从职责列转9px给日期列，保留工号、姓名、部门和职级宽度。测试日期能否更多地在连字符处换行，同时观察职责列收窄后词组断行和行高的代价。

d3r4A.idea: 将部门列收窄至逐字排列，把空间让给职责；保留足以完整显示年份的日期宽度。检验职责明显变宽是否值得牺牲部门的查找速度。

d3r4B.idea: 保留双字宽的姓名和部门列，增加日期空间以保护年份和数字片段，同时观察职责列收窄后的实际换行代价。

d2r5A.idea: 从职责列拨6px给日期，检验能否让日期稳定分成两行，同时保留现有姓名和部门宽度；需观察职责缩窄后的词语拆分与行高代价。

d2r5B.idea: 从部门列拨5px给职责，检验职责多容纳中文字符后能否改善长段阅读；需重点观察部门名称是否过度碎裂。

d3r5A.idea: 从部门列调出 9px 给日期列，尝试保留完整年份和月日，同时维持 d3r1B 的职责宽度；需要检验 44px 部门列是否仍能容纳两个汉字。

d3r5B.idea: 加宽姓名列，使三字姓名有机会保持完整，并保留两字宽的部门列及完整年份；检验职责列显著收窄后的行高和断词是否还能接受。

s0A.idea: Test one more pixel for dates while retaining approximately four Chinese characters of text width for responsibilities. This may preserve more complete years without increasing responsibility line counts; the rendered result needs verification.

s0B.idea: Test the largest date allocation that still leaves 60 px of nominal text width for responsibilities. It may improve date breaks further, but borders, glyph metrics and punctuation could cause additional wrapping, so it must be compared in a render.

s1A.idea: Give dates enough room for their longest unbreakable unit while preserving the current name width. Test whether the narrower department and duties columns remain readable.

s1B.idea: Keep the wider date column and give duties two more pixels than Layout Q, using narrower name and department columns. Check the resulting name and department breaks.

s1C.idea: Test a wider grade column to keep its header on one line alongside the wider date column. Compare the header improvement against the cost of narrower duties.

s2A.idea: 保留Q中便于查找的姓名和部门宽度，将日期恢复到s1B的64px，争取避免年份内部断开；检查职责栏收窄后是否仍可接受。

s2B.idea: 在日期和职责之间取中间值，检验61px是否足以保持年份完整，同时比上一方案为职责保留更多空间。

contrast.idea: This near-equal allocation fits the width but gives the employee identifiers less than their measured unbreakable width plus padding. It also leaves the long responsibilities text severely constrained while giving the short rank values unnecessary space.

d2r1A.why: 工号完整，日期多半按年份与月日分行，但职责栏很窄，中文词组频繁断开，长行记录使其他列出现大片空白；职级和职责表头也被拆行。

d1r1A.why: 职责表头完整，正文比 A 更易连读，工号也完整；但多数日期的年份被拆开，查找和比较入职日期困难，姓名和部门也频繁换行。

contrast.why: 等宽分配使工号断行，职责栏每行只有很少的字，长记录延伸至 17 行；大量纵向空白和断开的词组严重妨碍查找及阅读。

d3r1B.why: 工号和职责表头完整，职责正文相对较宽，整体也较紧凑；但姓名、部门和职责仍有许多不自然的断行，部分日期的年份被拆开，影响比较。

ref_auto.why: 日期多按年份与月日分行，职责栏较宽；但姓名和部门逐字竖向排列，多个表头拆行，员工身份与所属部门难以快速识别。

acceptance.unsure: D 与 B 仅有 1 像素的列宽差异，取舍较接近；D 的部分年份仍被拆开，而 A 和 E 的日期分行较自然。所有方案都受手机宽度限制，阅读体验明显受损。

contrast.why: Employee IDs split across lines, dates fragment, and the responsibilities column forces text into very narrow stacks. The resulting tall rows make comparison difficult.

d3r1B.why: IDs remain whole and responsibilities have enough width for relatively continuous reading. Names and departments wrap, however, and some years split within the date, making date lookup harder.

d1r1A.why: The responsibilities column reads much like B, but the slightly narrower date column splits more years and makes one short row taller. IDs remain easy to scan.

d2r1A.why: IDs stay whole and dates generally break at hyphens, aiding lookup. The narrower responsibilities column produces more fragmented phrases and substantially taller rows; its header also wraps awkwardly.

ref_auto.why: Dates and responsibilities have useful width, but names and departments become one-character stacks. This disrupts recognition and makes even short entries occupy tall rows; four headers wrap.

acceptance.unsure: B and D trade responsibility readability against date readability. D could be preferable if comparing dates is the dominant task; B's split years are a significant weakness.

d1r1A.why: 工号保持完整，主要职责的表头也在一行；但日期多处把年份拆开，部门和职责频繁断行，查阅与连续阅读都费力。

d3r1B.why: 工号完整，职责列相对宽裕；部分日期仍把年份拆开，部门和职责的断行也不自然，但行高分布比 A 略紧凑。

contrast.why: 等宽分配把工号拆成两行，职责列仅容纳很少的字，长记录被拉成细长文字柱；跨行定位和比较十分吃力。

d2r1A.why: 工号完整，多数日期按年份与月日分行；但职责列更窄，表头和正文都被频繁切断，长行记录显著增高。

ref_auto.why: 日期和职责获得较多空间，但姓名与部门几乎逐字竖排，四个表头换行，姓名和部门的快速识别受到明显影响。

acceptance.unsure: A 与 B 仅相差 1px 的日期和职责列宽；B 的日期断行及行高略有改善，但两者整体质量非常接近。所有方案都受窄屏约束，职责和日期的断行仍明显影响阅读。

d3r1B.why: Employee numbers stay whole and the name and department headers fit, but names, departments and dates wrap heavily. The narrow responsibilities column makes long entries difficult to read.

L04.why: Employee numbers remain whole, but dates break within the year throughout the table. One short record becomes taller, adding empty space across its row.

L06.why: Employee numbers stay whole, but the name header and every name are reduced to single-character lines. Dates and responsibilities are also fragmented.

L01.why: Two employee numbers split across lines, making a key lookup field harder to scan. Names, departments and dates also wrap, while long responsibilities remain dense.

L05.why: Four employee numbers split across lines, impairing lookup. The wider name column does not visibly resolve name wrapping, and dates and responsibilities remain fragmented.

L03.why: Employee numbers stay whole, but the department header and department names run one character per line. This lengthens short rows and makes department comparison laborious.

L02.why: The department column forces its header and values into single-character lines, producing tall rows and large empty areas. The wider name column still leaves names wrapped.

L07.why: Employee numbers stay whole, but the name header and names run one character per line. The wider department column still leaves department names broken across several lines.

landscape.unsure: All layouts appear structurally intact, but their narrow date and responsibilities columns impose substantial reading costs. The relative penalty for splitting employee numbers versus names depends on which field readers use most for lookup.

L03.why: 工号完整，但部门逐字竖排，部门和职级表头也被拆开；日期与职责频繁断行，长行造成大量空白。

d3r1B.why: 工号完整，姓名和部门表头保持一行，部门以两字为主换行；日期仍拆开年份，职责列狭窄，查读费力。

L04.why: 工号完整，部门可按短词组阅读，但更窄的日期列把每个年份拆开，增加行高并妨碍日期比较。

L05.why: 多个工号末位被挤到下一行，损害花名册的关键查找功能；日期和职责也有较多断行。

L06.why: 工号完整，但姓名表头和所有姓名都逐字竖排，辨认人员困难；多出的工号列宽没有改善阅读。

L01.why: 姓名和部门的分配尚可，但首尾两条工号被拆行，影响查找；日期和职责仍然零碎。

L02.why: 工号完整，但部门及其表头逐字竖排；姓名列的额外宽度未能避免较长姓名换行，行高也被部门拉长。

L07.why: 工号完整，但姓名表头和姓名逐字竖排，人员查找困难；部门列更宽却仍需多行显示。

landscape.unsure: 所有布局的日期和职责列都很窄；中文词语断行计数只是辅助指标，个别断行的语义影响仍需结合上下文判断。

L11.why: 工号完整，但部门逐字竖排，部门和职级表头也被拆开；日期中的年份有时断开，职责文字窄而零碎。

L13.why: 部门比 A 更易读，但每个工号都被拆成两行，妨碍按编号查找；日期和职责仍有大量断行。

d3r1B.why: 工号完整，部门以双字为主换行，列分配较均衡；但姓名、日期和职责仍有不自然的断行，比较日期尤其费力。

L08.why: 工号完整，但部门仍逐字竖排，表头有三列换行；较宽的姓名列没有明显改善姓名断行。

L09.why: 工号完整，部门按双字换行；但入职日期表头逐字堆叠，所有年份都被拆开，日期查阅困难，表头也显得过高。

L12.why: 日期列过窄，表头逐字堆叠，年份和部分月日数字被拆散；职级列多出的宽度对简短内容帮助有限。

L10.why: 工号和年份完整，日期较易辨认；但职责列更窄，表头被拆开，长职责形成很高的文字带，阅读和跨行查找都费力。

L14.why: 工号完整，但姓名表头和所有姓名都逐字竖排；工号列的额外宽度未带来相应收益，日期和职责仍较零碎。

landscape.unsure: 各方案均受手机宽度严重限制；B 的工号断行、H 的姓名竖排和 G 的职责长列之间如何取舍，取决于读者更常按什么查找。正确性评分依据图中未见裁切或重叠。

L13.why: Employee IDs break across lines, making lookup harder. Dates and department names also fragment, although the responsibility column retains a relatively consistent measure.

L12.why: IDs stay whole, but the date heading stacks one character per line and dates split into irregular fragments, making comparisons difficult.

L10.why: IDs stay whole and some dates break more naturally, but the narrower responsibility column creates very short lines and tall rows; its heading also wraps.

d3r1B.why: Whole employee IDs support lookup, while the responsibility heading stays on one line. Names, departments and dates still wrap awkwardly, and long duties remain hard to read.

L08.why: Department names and their heading stack one character at a time, making a key lookup field slow to scan and adding height even to short-duty rows.

L09.why: The slightly wider responsibility column leaves the date heading stacked character by character and breaks years within dates; IDs remain easy to scan.

L11.why: Department names and their heading stack one character per line, impeding comparison. The extra width in the grade column brings little visible benefit.

L14.why: IDs are whole, but the name heading and every name stack character by character. The extra ID-column space comes at the expense of a primary lookup field.

landscape.unsure: All layouts fit and appear structurally intact, but the narrow viewport forces substantial wrapping. E and G look effectively equivalent at the rendered line breaks; the relative severity of fragmented dates, names and duties depends on the reader’s lookup task.
